purpose: Test whether the Draw Top1 failure is primarily decision geometry by mapping a strictly-prior learned A-D-H latent strength score into an automatically calibrated central Draw band on a sixth disjoint 100-match sample.

algorithm.family: strictly-prior same-competition ordinal central-band ridge classifier
algorithm.standardization: median/IQR from each target's strictly-prior same-competition pool only
algorithm.band_rule: Fit latent ridge on strictly-prior rows. Score the same prior rows and target. Set lower threshold at prior fitted-score quantile equal to prior Away rate and upper threshold at quantile equal to prior Away+Draw cumulative rate. Predict A below lower, D in the central band, H above upper.

frozen_gate.if_pass: Decision geometry is a credible Draw Top1 mechanism and may proceed to a separately preregistered probabilistic ordinal model; no formal promotion.
frozen_gate.if_fail: Central-band decision geometry does not solve Draw Top1 on this representation; stop this route.
